LanguageData.VGE2_AstrofuelBarrel.label: astrofuel barrel
LanguageData.VGE2_AstrofuelBarrel.description: A barrel of volatile astrofuel. It will explode if damaged.
LanguageData.VGE2_AstrofuelPipeSegment.label: astrofuel pipe segment
LanguageData.VGE2_AstrofuelPipeSegment.description: A long segment of an overground astrofuel pipe. It will explode if damaged, and will leak astrofuel when damaged.
LanguageData.VGE2_ExplosivesCrate.label: explosives crate
LanguageData.VGE2_ExplosivesCrate.description: A container of mining charges. It will explode if damaged.
LanguageData.VGE2_FloorOxygenVent.label: floor oxygen vent
LanguageData.VGE2_FloorOxygenVent.description: An oxygen vent leading to a deeper oxygen installation, continuously pushing oxygen into the room.
LanguageData.VGE2_LockedShuttle.label: locked shuttle
LanguageData.VGE2_LockedShuttle.description: A chemfuel-powered shuttle designed for long-distance travel, typically utilized by the trading guild. Heavy magnetic clamps prevent it from being operated without authorization, but it can still be deconstructed to obtain the shuttle engine.
LanguageData.VGE2_NavBeacon.label: nav beacon
LanguageData.VGE2_NavBeacon.description: A ship navigation beacon. Used to help shuttles and larger vessels with docking procedures.
LanguageData.VGE2_OrbitalLight.label: orbital light
LanguageData.VGE2_OrbitalLight.description: An internally powered standing lamp that lights an area. People need light to move and work at full speed. In case of loss of pressure, the light will turn red.
LanguageData.VGE2_Oxyfarm.label: oxyfarm
LanguageData.VGE2_Oxyfarm.description: A small, self-contained tank filled with engineered oxyalgae, capable of producing oxygen in small, steady quantities.
LanguageData.VGE2_PowerSocket.label: power socket
LanguageData.VGE2_PowerSocket.description: A medium-sized power socket emerging from a deeper capacitor bank under the floor. Constantly generates a steady supply of power.
LanguageData.VGE2_SpacerCrate.label: spacer crate
LanguageData.VGE2_SpacerCrate.description: A spacer, futuristic crate with nothing of value in it.
LanguageData.VGE2_StationAntenna.label: station antenna
LanguageData.VGE2_StationAntenna.description: A precise but fragile antenna used to transmit communications between the orbital stations.
LanguageData.VGE2_StationEquipmentBlock.label: station equipment block
LanguageData.VGE2_StationEquipmentBlock.description: A modular array of station equipment blocks, kept in perfect working order. These units handle critical station logistics and system maintenance.
LanguageData.VGE2_StationConsole.label: station console
LanguageData.VGE2_StationConsole.description: A special console used to monitor and control various subsystems of the orbital station.
LanguageData.VGE2_SmallStationConsole.label: small station console
LanguageData.VGE2_SmallStationConsole.description: A special console used to monitor and control various subsystems of the orbital station.
LanguageData.VGE2_StationFilingCabinet.label: station filing cabinet
LanguageData.VGE2_StationFilingCabinet.description: A filing cabinet containing some documents, critical and not, related to the orbital station.
LanguageData.VGE2_StationLockerBank.label: station locker bank
LanguageData.VGE2_StationLockerBank.description: A bank of lockers. Used on orbital stations to hold personal belongings of crewmembers.
LanguageData.VGE2_StationSystemRack.label: station system rack
LanguageData.VGE2_StationSystemRack.description: A rack unit packed with unidentifiable devices. Nothing on it seems particularly valuable.
LanguageData.VGE2_TradingContainer.label: trading container
LanguageData.VGE2_TradingContainer.description: A large sealed container belonging to some sort of orbital trader’s stockpile. It may contain valuable supplies, but needs to be destroyed to release them.
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerPallet_Medicine.label: spacer medicine pallet
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerPallet_Medicine.description: A pallet containing medical supplies. Can be looted to yield medicine.
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerPallet_SurvivalMeals.label: spacer rations pallet
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerPallet_SurvivalMeals.descripti: A pallet containing stacked rations. Can be looted to yield survival meals.
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerBox_ComponentIndustrial.label: spacer component box
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerBox_ComponentIndustrial.descri: A spacer logistical box filled with valuable components. They’re intact and very usable.
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerBox_ComponentSpacer.label: spacer electronics box
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerBox_ComponentSpacer.descriptio: A spacer logistical box filled with electronics and advanced components. Everything seems to work fine.
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerBox_Steel.label: spacer steel box
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerBox_Steel.description: A spacer logistical box filled with steel scrap. It's heavy but might contain some recoverable metal.
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerBox_Gravlite.label: spacer gravlite box
LanguageData.VGE_SpacerBox_Gravlite.description: A spacer logistical box filled with gravlite panel chunks. While most of it seems like gravlite waste, some chunks appear intact.
LanguageData.VGE_StationLight_Blue.label: station light
LanguageData.VGE_StationLight_Blue.description: A special light panel wired to the station's main power source.
LanguageData.VGE_StationLight.label: station light
LanguageData.VGE_StationLight.description: A special light panel wired to the station's main power source.
LanguageData.VGE2_PosBeacon_Green.label: pos beacon
LanguageData.VGE2_PosBeacon_Green.description: An orbital station positioning beacon. Used to ensure the orbital station does not drift off-orbit.
LanguageData.VGE2_PosBeacon_Red.label: pos beacon
LanguageData.VGE2_PosBeacon_Red.description: An orbital station positioning beacon. Used to ensure the orbital station does not drift off-orbit.
LanguageData.VGE_AncientEmergencyLight_Orange.label: ancient warning light
LanguageData.VGE_InfestedGravlockTether.label: infested gravlock tether
LanguageData.VGE_InfestedGravlockTether.description: A corrupted gravlock tether that has been hollowed out and repurposed into a gigantic exoinsectoid hive. Integrated directly into the station's ventilation system, this pulsing structure continuously pumps larvae through the vents, spawning new insectoids that spread throughout the station.\n\nDestroy the infested gravlock tether to obtain a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_InfestedGravlockTether.comps.3.label: Infested gravlock tether
LanguageData.VGE_InfestedGravlockTether.comps.3.text: You detect the heavy signs of the exoinsectoid mega-hive nearby. The infested gravlock tether must be destroyed to yield valuable gravcore and stop the ongoing infestation.
LanguageData.VGE_InfestedVent.label: infested vent
LanguageData.VGE_InfestedVent.description: A broken down vent leading deeper into the orbital station installation. Chittering and movement can be heard down below.
LanguageData.VGE_OrbitalPirateFortifiedWall.label: fortified wall
LanguageData.VGE_OrbitalPirateFortifiedWall.descripti: A reinforced wall made of an ultratech polymer and patched up with whatever salvagers found.
LanguageData.VGE_SalvagerDropship.label: salvager dropship
LanguageData.VGE_SalvagerDropship.description: A chemfuel-powered heavily armored dropship equipped with rocketswarm launchers. Designed for carpet bombing and incursions into enemy territory. This particular dropship seems to belong to salvagers.
LanguageData.VGE_GlowstickPile_Green.label: glowstick pile
LanguageData.VGE_GlowstickPile_Green.description: A jumbled heap of glowsticks still spilling a soft, ethereal luminescence across the floor.
LanguageData.VGE_GlowstickPile_Orange.label: glowstick pile
LanguageData.VGE_GlowstickPile_Orange.description: A jumbled heap of glowsticks still spilling a soft, ethereal luminescence across the floor.
LanguageData.VGE_GlowstickPile_Blue.label: glowstick pile
LanguageData.VGE_GlowstickPile_Blue.description: A jumbled heap of glowsticks still spilling a soft, ethereal luminescence across the floor.
